cohort: The study included 1,591,932 singleton term deliveries in Hungary between 1999 and 2018 from the Hungarian Tauffer registry.
finding: Median birthweights in Hungary increased from 1999 to 2008 (girls: 3250g to 3300g; boys: 3400g to 3440g) and subsequently decreased until 2018 (girls: 3260g; boys: 3400g), with maternal age and gestational age explaining significant portions of these trends.
birth_weight: All birthweights of singleton term deliveries were included and analyzed, with observed median birthweights ranging from 3250g to 3440g.
